messages:
faiz_arch: quick brain-dump: propose a compact 'pin_matrix' manifest to express tenant+env -> variant weights to reduce per-tenant pins.

jo_prod: reduce storage sounds good. ops worry: how to trace which write caused an outage?

sam_runtime: runtime plan: maintain an index map tenant|env -> row id in memory, LRU cache for hot tenants, fallback to scanning blob. store numeric ids server-side.

faiz_arch: proto sketch: columns, rows array, meta {epoch, created_by, compat_ttl}, exceptions list for scoped overrides.

jo_prod: migration: prefer lazy co-existence; resolver checks explicit pins first then matrix, add compat_ttl so old pins auto-expire.

sam_runtime: telemetry: add resolved_source, matched_row_id, manifest_epoch, override_reason.

faiz_arch: RBAC: require stricter write controls + preflight dry-run for wide-scoped edits. UI should warn on >N tenant changes.

ci-bot: deploy-check: schema change detected (pin_matrix_v1). update migration runbook and perf test plan.
